description: [Procurement] Find the HS/commodity code and import duty for goods shipped into the UK or the US. Use when quoting landed cost or preparing a UK or US customs entry. Price: $0.004 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/hs-tariff

origin.description: Optional ISO2 origin country for UK preferential rates

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

query.description: Keyword search instead of a code, e.g. laptop

name: hs_tariff
title: Customs Tariff Lookup (UK Trade Tariff + US HTS) ($0.004)
